subtitleNullable: Polycystic ovary syndrome Sample Dataset based on Machine Learning Algorithm
descriptionNullable:
The PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome) dataset is a collection of data related to patients diagnosed with PCOS, a hormonal disorder commonly found in women of reproductive age. The dataset is available on Kaggle and was collected by Prasad et al.

The dataset includes 541 observations with 18 features, including demographic information such as age, weight, and height, as well as medical history, blood tests, and physical characteristics of the patients. The dataset also includes the results of an ultrasound examination(endometrium size), which is commonly used to diagnose PCOS.

Each observation in the dataset represents a patient who has been diagnosed with PCOS. The features in the dataset can be broadly categorized into the following groups:
